post.originalText:
I gave Claude Opus 5.5 one prompt: a voxel coral reef with schools of fish, a sunken shipwreck and light rays coming down from the surface.

It wrote the whole scene as one HTML file, looked at it in a browser and kept fixing it for 66 minutes. I didn't touch the code. https://t.co/CP6Hw8DfEl

sourceMaterials.text: @ThomasKanze Same, the little scuba diver with the torch in there gets the best seat

sourceMaterials.text: @VistaLargaGames Thanks! The bait ball of 480 sardines is my favorite part to watch
